Our Story

A Journey of Faith, Learning & Excellence

On 2 June 1999, Crescent Matriculation School commenced in a rented building on Saramedu Main Road with 100 students in Pre-KG and LKG. It was founded by community members — vendors, traders, working people and philanthropists — united by a vision to make quality English-medium, values-based education accessible to all, especially families in economically challenging circumstances.

Under the leadership of Chairman Haji A. Sulaiman and General Secretary Haji O.K.V. Mohamed Ibrahim, the school grew steadily. In 2005, a purpose-built campus was established at No. 3, Saramedu Main Road with 16 classrooms across two floors. Today the school serves students from Pre-KG through Higher Secondary, guided by the motto: Confidence · Effort · Target.

📖 Value-Based Learning 🕌 On-Campus Prayer Hall 🤝 Arabic from Basic Level 🏆 District & State Events 🌟 Minority Institution

Holistic Growth

Student Development

We believe education is more than academics — it's about shaping complete human beings ready for the world.

🌿

Spiritual & Moral Formation

Students grow in love of God, gratitude and humility, practising values such as compassion, forgiveness, courage, honesty, respect and joy in daily life.

💡

Intellectual Formation

Academic excellence pursued alongside the ability to think independently and apply classroom learning to real-life situations with confidence.

🏃

Physical & Aesthetic Formation

🌍

Social Formation

Developing pride in the nation's heritage, love and loyalty towards the country, respect for all people and sensitivity to the needs of fellow human beings.

Join Crescent

Admission Process

Admissions are granted based on seat availability, school norms, and the Principal's discretion. Begin your journey today.

ℹ️ Admission to any standard is subject to available seats, adherence to school norms, and approval by the Principal. Early enquiry is encouraged.
📞

Step 1 – Enquire

Call or visit our office to enquire about seat availability for your child's standard.

📝

Step 2 – Application

Collect and complete the admission application form from the school office.

📁

Step 3 – Documents

Submit required documents including birth certificate, transfer certificate, and previous mark sheets.

✅

Step 4 – Fee Formalities

Complete the fee formalities to confirm your child's admission and secure the seat.
